lines: The first to launch their attack was Kaworu.
She swung her hand sharply downward, and a new chain appeared out of her palm.
The pointed end of the chain attacked Rinko-senpai, making a terrible clatter.
Without flinching in the slightest, Rinko-senpai nimbly dodged the chain like she was dancing, and closed the distance.
Kaworu made a further chain emerge.
The fifth chain stretched out towards Rinko-senpai's chest.
It was at this point that she drew her sword for the first time.
“Ishikiri Kanemitsu”, an Akiyama family heirloom, whooshed through the air.
The force of that repelled the end of the chain, and Rinko-senpai shortened the distance from Kaworu even further, without diminishing her flow in the slightest.
She was good. Fluid movements, which I was only just barely able to catch now that I had been trained by Library.
Rinko-senpai was trying to get Kaworu in range for a killer blow.
Countless spacial transference bubbles were created.
That was a precursor to Rinko-senpai's secret sword skill, “Butterfly Guillotine”, an arcane technique of the Stray Blade Style.
By covering the blade of Ishikiri Kanemitsu in spacial leap bubbles, she would force whatever parts the blade touched to leap somewhere.
As a result, anything touched by it would be cut in two in a single stroke.
It was a fearsome, literally certain-death sword technique, which would neutralize any kind of armour.
The moment she was about to unleash a strike that was impossible to defend,
A sixth chain stretched out like it was crawling along the ground, and wrapped around Rinko-senpai's legs.
A steel chain that increased in heaviness in proportion to the weight of a person's sins.
Restrained by that, her legs suddenly stopped.
「There's no one who can escape from my chains. It's over.」
She must have thought the tables had turned.
Rinko-senpai said, not the slightest bit shaken, but rather like she understood.
「If it weren't for Fuuma-kun's advice, I would have been defeated. Chains that have even captured Sakura-sensei. That's a formidable Ninja Art.」
「Would have been defeated? What are you talking about?!」
「Kaworu-dono can wield up to six chains. That's what I'm told.」
「The young Lord put that idea in your head, hmm?」
About the properties of Kaworu's “Wicked Chain Bondage”, and how to counteract it.
Albeit momentarily, even Kaworu was shaken, being told the secret of her own Ninja Art by an opponent.
Just that much of an opening had been enough.
No longer were the spacial leap bubbles covering the blade of Ishikiri Kanemitsu.
What they were instead covering was Rinko-senpai's body.
With that mutter, the bubbles soundlessly burst.
The chain had been sent off somewhere and disappeared, and she had been freed from her bonds.
Kaworu pulled back, but she was one step too late.
A deadly slash headed straight for her body and―――
A blow that was certain to split Kaworu in two——The one who had saved her from that was Kaura.
All of a sudden, her demonic sword had wedged itself in between them and blocked Rinko-senpai's strike.
「For me to not be able to cut it in a single slash... Is that a kind of magic sword?!」
Without a moment's delay, Kaworu pulled back, and Kaura blocked the way in front of Rinko-senpai.
「So you're telling me to bring you down first, then?」
Rinko-senpai calmly readied Ishikiri Kanemitsu in the Hassou stance.
「Haha, that grandiose pose! You're some kinda school of swordsman, huh?」
「I hate that sort of stuff. So I'm gonna take away your soul with this!」
「Take this, and this, and this and thiiisss!!」
A series of attacks that wouldn't even allow her time to breathe. What was more, they were all erratic.
A diagonal downward strike instantly transformed into an upward slash at her neck, and the moment that was dodged, her wrists were targeted next.

A lunge that seemed to have been reaching for her chest changed its trajectory midway through, her feet were slashed at horizontally, and then, without stopping, the tip shot upwards, aiming for her throat.
Even Kaura herself darted around wildly to the left and right, sometimes even somersaulting, as she swung her sword from every direction.
It was the same as when she had routed the armed refugees. It was inconstant swordsmanship, which had no set form, and put her primal instincts on display.
「What's wrong, what's wrong? You afraid of my demonic sword?! Eh, Traditional Swordsman-sama?!」
Rinko-senpai was purely on the defensive. Or rather, she was dealing with the sword, which was hard to even follow with your eyes, using the minimum amount of movement necessary.
「Swordsmanship honed through combat experience, huh? Quite sharp.」
「I've taken the souls of a lot of bigshot swordsmen. Soon, I'll be doing that to you, too!」
「Those people must not have had enough training.」
With just one swing, Kaura's demonic sword was sent flying out of its owner's hand, and tumbled impotently to the floor.
Though she may have wielded a demonic blade, she was a warden, not a swordfighter.
She was no match for Rinko-senpai, who held the nickname of The Slasher.
Kaura stood stock still from the excessive shock.
That secret, impossible-to-defend sword move was unleashed again.
Acting on impulsive instinct, Kaura screamed and covered her head with her hands.
However, what Rinko-senpai had slashed was not the warden, who had lost the will to fight.
Nor was it Kaworu, whom she had planned to take down at the beginning, and who had reflexively put herself on guard in preparation for an attack.
She had severed every single one of the chains that Kaworu was still extending, including the ones that were restraining Sakura-sensei and the twin oni.
「All right! I'm free! Thank you, Rinko-chan!」
This was also part of the plan.
Since we hadn't been able to defeat her with the initial surprise attack, it was natural for us to carry out our sub-plan.
i.e., “Escape is a form of victory.”
Sakura-sensei promptly lifted one of the twin oni into her arms.
「Th-That's not...... Ngah! Don't struggle like that!! Fugaah!」
Despite getting kicked in the chin, Shikanosuke also gathered the other one into his arms, and ran over to Rinko-senpai.
Lilim, who hadn't done anything, was already clinging to her side.
「Knock it off with the “Chief” stuff! Rinko-senpai!!」
Rinko-senpai's spacial transference bubbles enveloped us.
Kaworu produced chains again, and fired them at us.
Six chains whooshed toward us, but they didn't make it in time.
A split second quicker, we had fled the scene via Rinko-senpai's spacial leap.
The chains had fruitlessly snagged nothing but air.
「They won't be able to leap far! After them!!!」
Kaura, who had been stunned, rushed out of there as if running away, taking her guard underlings with her.
In the underground cell, from which everyone had disappeared, Kaworu let a chuckle slip out.
「“Fuuma-kun's advice,” eh? I'm glad to hear you've grown, Young Lord-sama......」
That was Kaworu's closest secret, unknown not only by her subordinate, Kaura, but even most of the Fuuma.
Because, no matter if they were allies, making that known would be no different from telling them her weakness.
She never imagined that the young Lord would have grasped that, and told it to his ally Taimanin.
「He really meant to kill me, didn't he? As a woman of the Fuuma, I'm delighted.」
The fact that he hadn't even tried to show himself, despite knowing that his opponent was Kaworu, also left a favourable impression of him as someone in a leadership position.
The Taimanin named Onisaki Kirara must have come on the young Lord's orders.
That woman was no ordinary person either, switching to escape without hesitation as soon as she saw that they couldn't bring Kaworu down.
「Next time, I'd like to meet you properly, Young Lord-sama. Fufufufufufu......」
Laughter mixed between joy and bloodthirst spread throughout the underground cell, where silence had returned.
A few days later, I finally returned to Gosha.

We had gotten away from our pursuers (both the guard squad that Kaura led and some Taimanin from the Tekkain family), and safeguarded the oni twins, Yuffie and Sophie, in Gosha. Mission complete, safe and sound.
A few problematic situations had occurred, but all things considered, I guess you could say it had gone well.
The biggest problem for me, the seal piercings, had been safely removed by Kiryuu-sensei before I gave Kirara-senpai her body back.
Of course, it was a secret from everyone. If Kirara-senpai found out, then even though it was mission accomplished, there would still be one casualty: me.
Setting that aside, the whole time up until we got back to Gosha, I had been observing those oni twins as much as I could.
As one would expect from being “humanoid weapons”, I had a feeling that those two weren't the kind of people we could safeguard at Gosha forever.
Childlike innocence and ruthlessness, and combat ability that was difficult to control because of that.
Whether it was them or Saya NEO, it seemed like there was a common issue when it came to the UFS's developmental capabilities.
I had just turned in a report to Asagi-sensei, including things like that.
「Hey, Fuuma-chan, why don't we stop by Inageya?」
「Hebiko knows you don't have money. It sounds like you worked hard this time, so Hebiko will treat you, as a reward.」
「Oh, that's much appreciated! Let's go, let's go!」
「Then, do I get to be treated too, Hebiko?」
「Eh? Shikanosuke-chan didn't work that hard, did he?」
「On top of getting caught easily and causing trouble for Fuuma-chan, Hebiko heard you were doing kitchen work in prison.」
「It's not like I was doing that 'cause I really wanted to! There was no choice! Plus, up until Fuuma arrived, I was gathering intelligence and stuff by myself, too!」
「Well, I guess the info about the inside of the prison was a little helpful......」
「But, we wouldn't have needed to go to all that trouble to infiltrate the prison if Shikanosuke hadn't screwed up in the first place......」
「Oi, Fuuma, you're gonna put it like that?!」
「Right. Then Hebiko won't treat Shikanosuke-chan after all.」
「Shiiit, only Fuuma... Even though I worked hard too... Even though I went through an awful time...!」
He certainly had been through an awful time.
Since he had been incarcerated in that prison, Shikanosuke must have had the same old piercings put on him too.
I say “must”, because I naturally hadn't asked him anything about it. Like where they would put them on a man.
However, I knew that after we got back to Gosha, Shikanosuke had secretly gone to Kiryuu-sensei.
「Haah, must be nice for Fuuma, turning his body into Kirara-senpai's, and stuff......」
「It wasn't very nice. Which reminds me, Hebiko. How was Kirara-senpai while I was gone over there?」
「Mmmmm. It seemed like she took a liking to Fuuma-chan's body.」
「Really? She didn't say anything like that to me, though.」
「She said it's comfortable because it's so light.」
「Light? I'm heavier than her, aren't I?」
「Not your body weight...... You know, the chest and such.」
Then, even after we've gotten our bodies back to normal, was she going to come and ask me to do a swap again?
I had done that because it was a mission.
To be in Kirara-senpai's body every day wouldn't be good for a young man's mental health.
Well, when we got to Inageya, making a racket in front of the store were the horned pair, and Lilim, who had a pair that made you horny.
On their request, Lilim had become the oni twins' playmate, and was shamelessly sticking around in Gosha.
The trio's guardian (or guard, rather) was Sakura-sensei.
「Onee-chan, you said children should eat a lot.」
「Well, I did, but... Sophie and Yuffie are one thing, but can't Lilim pay for herself?」
「Ha ha ha! I'm fresh out of prison, so I'm flat broke!」
「Awwww...... Come on, even grown-ups don't have infinite pocket money......」
Being squeezed for money by the three of them, Sakura-sensei was making a miserable face.
After we'd gotten home to Gosha, she had been severely scolded by Asagi-sensei about making a mistake and getting captured.
She had looked more dispirited than when she was bound by Kaworu's chains, and it seemed that her punishment was still ongoing.
Any way you looked at it, that was a group who seemed like they were going to cause trouble.
All I could do was pray not to get involved with them as much as possible.
After being treated to ice cream by Hebiko and spending some time at Inageya, I parted ways with the two of them.
I was at a point where I would arrive home after a little more walking, when I was called out to.
It was a person I had never seen before.
She was a student of Gosha Academy.
My senpai, going by the colour of the tie on her uniform.
A very beautiful girl with short hair.
「Um, do you need something from me?」
